_comment: Pre-flight checklist for the framework demo. Only machine checks that
need no hardware, so the gate genuinely passes on any machine — that is what
makes this usable as a smoke test of the whole chain.

checklist.text: [HARD] The kernel can give CycloneDDS the receive buffer its config demands. net.core.rmem_max is NOT persistent across reboots; when it reverts, EVERY node dies at rmw_create_node and the rest of this gate reports symptoms instead of the cause (2026-08-19).

[HARD] No leftover talker from a previous run: exactly this trial's talker binary is running (the gate runs after the launch since 2026-07-29, so the pattern names the binary, lib/demo_nodes_cpp/talker; the plain 'demo_nodes_cpp' also matched the `ros2 run` wrapper and refused every trial, found by the E3 execution on 2026-10-02).
Enough disk for the (tiny) demo bag.
[HARD] The bag directory is writable on the machine that will record.

checklist: Nothing physical to check — this demo has no robot, which is the point.
